    INNER JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments sda ON dep.department_id = sda.department_id
    INNER JOIN Staff stf ON sda.staff_id = stf.staff_id
    CROSS JOIN Product_Suppliers ps
    WHERE DATE(ps.date_supplied_from) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
       OR (DATE(ps.date_supplied_from) < '2017-01-01' 
           AND (ps.date_supplied_to IS NULL OR DATE(ps.date_supplied_to) >= '2017-01-01'))
    GROUP BY dsc.dept_store_chain_name
    HAVING num_suppliers >= 3
),
filtered_2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.*,
        strftime('%Y-%m', ps.date_supplied_from) AS month
    FROM Product_Suppliers ps
    WHERE DATE(ps.date_supplied_from) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
       OR (DATE(ps.date_supplied_from) < '2017-01-01' 
           AND (ps.date_supplied_to IS NULL OR DATE(ps.date_supplied_to) >= '2017-01-01'))
),

),

)

        PARTITION BY dept_store_chain_name 
        ORDER BY month
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_cumulative_total
FROM monthly_aggregates
ORDER BY dept_store_chain_name, month;

    UNION ALL

),

        m.month_start,
        m.month_end,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.product_price),0) AS sales_value
    FROM months m
    LEFT JOIN Customer_Orders o ON o.order_date BETWEEN m.month_start AND m.month_end
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY m.month_start, m.month_end
),
staff_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.month_start,
        m.month_end,
        d.department_id,
        d.department_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sda.staff_id) AS staff_count
    FROM months m
    JOIN Departments d ON 1=1
    LEFT JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments sda 
        ON sda.department_id = d.department_id
        AND sda.date_assigned_from <= m.month_end
        AND (sda.date_assigned_to IS NULL OR sda.date_assigned_to >= m.month_end)
    GROUP BY m.month_start, m.month_end, d.department_id, d.department_name
),
supplier_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        m.month_start,
        m.month_end,
        COUNT(*) AS supplier_changes
    FROM months m
    LEFT JOIN Supplier_Addresses sa 
        ON sa.date_from BETWEEN m.month_start AND m.month_end
    GROUP BY m.month_start, m.month_end
)
